The pole-sitter won in: San Marino, Spain, Austria, France, Britain, Germany, Hungary, Italy and Japan.

I checked all 16 race results. The pole-sitter did not win in the other seven: Australia (Coulthard won from grid 11), Malaysia (Räikkönen from grid 7), Brazil (Fisichella from grid 8), Monaco (Montoya from grid 3), Canada (M. Schumacher from grid 3), Europe (R. Schumacher from grid 3) and the United States (M. Schumacher from grid 7). In Brazil and Europe the grid-1 driver does not appear in the top 10, so I could not confirm who started from pole there, but the winner started from elsewhere in both cases.

ANSWER: 9
